verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Coinbase publishes CDP client SDK code on GitHub (coinbase/cdp-sdk), so some product-side source is publicly readable. Nothing in the pack names a license, and the hosted payments service itself appears closed. Missing for 10: evidence of an open license (e.g. MIT/Apache) on the repo, source availability for the core payments platform beyond client libraries, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Client libraries for managing EVM and Solana wallets while relying on CDP to secure private keys.
enables developers to programmatically create, manage, and use crypto wallets while relying on CDP to secure private keys.
